justaddwater.dkArchive record / 23 October 2026

Recovered, repaired,
preserved.

What we brought back while moving justaddwater.dk from WordPress to a static archive.

Some material survived only in backups or web archives. Some was still there, hidden by broken plugins. Other resources worked, but relied on someone else’s server. This report keeps those stories separate.

ChangesEvery affected pageLocal resource inventoryStill missing & deferred

Articles and demos with specific changes
151
Code examples repaired
61
Gist files preserved inline
14
Local resource records
252

Counts overlap. A recovered image can also be a locally preserved resource. Source URLs can share one file.

Three kinds of improvement

Recovered content Material recovered from backups, archives or an approved replacement upload. Adaptations and replacements are labeled.

Rendering & behavior Code, tags, layout and demos that now display or behave as their surviving source intended.

Kept locally Files or inline content that no longer need their former external host. YouTube videos are not counted here.

Still missing, adapted or deferred

A record of improvements should also make the limits easy to find.

18 external image references remain unavailable
Native broken-image rendering is preserved, including alt text and dimensions. The retired FeedBurner badge is separately replaced by the local RSS icon. Record
Missing decorative styles and legacy files
78 decorative-image URLs and two obsolete IE5 stylesheet imports were not recovered. Many decorations are unused banner variants. The exact train v6 demo, old spreadsheet stylesheet and IE6 PNG workaround also remain unavailable. Record
Flickr photo-page destinations remain external
Embedded images are local. Thumbnail links to Flickr photo pages were deliberately retained; downloading the largest versions and changing those destinations is deferred. Record
The screenshot audit still requires review
The recorded full comparison covers 2,522 URLs and 1,704 browser pairs. Its 1,076 URLs with pending visual differences are not 1,076 confirmed defects. Three articles have image-layout differences specifically left for review. This ledger is not a passing pixel-equivalence certificate. Record
Hosted players and historical interaction limits
YouTube remains an intentional external dependency. Mojiti overlays are lost. Forms needing WordPress no longer submit; browser-only demonstrations remain interactive. Record
Image-layout differences specifically left for review

About this record

This report consolidates the reviewed recovery manifests and indexes the generated HTML and CSS. It does not fetch or publish the private WordPress XML, database dump, drafts, email addresses or IP metadata. The evidence dates from the migration on 22–23 October 2026; links to the original site are for comparison and may degrade later.

Routine migration changes are recorded in the README: static search and scoped feeds, retained but non-submitting forms, updated footer wording, response anchors, removal of duplicate IDs and tracking scripts, and locally served theme assets. Those are not counted as newly recovered historical content.

The detailed screenshot audit remains local because it is large and tied to the capture cache. Its public summary is linked here; this report does not replace it or automatically approve its outstanding visual reviews.
